headline: Vucic Resigns the Presidency to Seek the Premiership
deck: On Sunday Aleksandar Vucic formally left Serbia’s presidency before his second term ended, and Al Jazeera records the move as a bid for the prime minister’s post in a snap parliamentary election on October 25.
body: Aleksandar Vucic formally resigned as president of Serbia on Sunday before completing his second term [E2]. Al Jazeera reports that the resignation is to seek the prime minister’s post in a snap parliamentary election on October 25 [E1].
Al Jazeera places that bid against a student-led movement it describes as mounting the most serious challenge to his rule in more than a decade [E1].
